subject: Re: LaunchPad cohort credit issuance and self-serve activation
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@equinorth.vc>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: cohort-ops@launchpad.org
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LaunchPad cohort credit request — roster attached

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the chat earlier this week. LaunchPad is finalizing our summer cohort (Wave 12) and we'd like to confirm the logistics for the free credits you provide to participating startups. We've attached the roster (CSV) with company names, primary admin email, and expected monthly token usage estimates.

Questions:
- Can Redwood issue self-serve promo codes for each company so founders can redeem directly in the PLG signup flow?
- Are codes single-use per account or can they be applied to an organization scope?
- Is there an expiration window you recommend for cohort credits?

We have a signed MOU template we can attach but wanted to confirm the issuance flow first. Target activation date is 2025-07-21.

Appreciate any quick notes.

Best,
Emma Li
Partnerships Manager, EquiNorth / LaunchPad Accelerator
attachments: launchpad_cohort_roster.csv (text/csv, 1.2KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@equinorth.vc>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LaunchPad cohort credit request — roster attached

Emma — thanks, got the roster. CC'ing Marissa (sales ops) who will own the issuance. Quick answers up front:

- Yes, we can provide single-use promo codes that redeem in the self-serve PLG flow (preferred for founder onboarding).
- We can also issue org-scoped codes on request, but that requires a short verification step (domain confirm + admin claim).
- Default expiration: 12 months from issuance. If you need shorter windows (e.g., cohort-specific), we can set custom expiry per batch.

Two asks to speed this:
1) Can you confirm company admin email domains for the org-scope option (if you prefer org-scoped codes)?
2) Please attach the signed MOU (or a short approval email) so Sales Ops has written authorization to issue the codes.

Marissa — once you confirm, can you prepare a CSV formatted for our issuance tool and schedule the activation window (target 2025-07-21)?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@equinorth.vc>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LaunchPad cohort credit request — roster attached

Emma / Karthik — looping in the step-by-step and what we need from you. Quoting Karthik: 
> Can you confirm company admin email domains for the org-scope option...

Issuance steps (self-serve promo flow — single-use codes):
1) We convert your roster into our promo CSV (columns: company_name, admin_email, promo_code, credit_amount, expiry_date).
2) We upload the batch into the promo engine and mark codes as redeemable via PLG signup.
3) Founders redeem code during signup; redeemed credits apply at org level once admin confirms email.
4) We email founders with redemption instructions + a short FAQ.

Org-scoped codes (optional):
- If you want org-scoped redemption (preferred for cohort admins), we will validate one admin email per company and require a short verification link click from that admin.
- This adds ~24 hours to the activation timeline.

What we need from LaunchPad to proceed today:
- Signed MOU or email OK to issue (attached field in Docusign works)
- Final roster with admin_email confirmed (we can take the attached CSV if correct)
- Desired credit allocation per company (example: 100k tokens / company).

I'll prepare the promo CSV once we have the signed MOU. If you want us to go org-scoped, please flag the companies in the roster.

Attachments: sample_promo_template.csv (internal), issuance_checklist.pdf

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Emma / team — quick operational confirmation from product/partner ops side. Thank you for the signed MOU and the finalized roster. Per Marissa's checklist, Promo Ops has completed the following:

- Batch uploaded to promo engine at 2025-07-20T14:50:00-07:00 with 100,000 token allocation per company (as requested).
- Codes are single-use and redeemable in the self-serve PLG signup flow. Upon redemption, credits are applied at the org level after admin confirmation.
- Expiry set to 2026-07-20 (12 months). We can shorten if you prefer.
- Unused credits do not auto-roll into a subsequent cohort; unused balance remains on the org and is consumed FIFO unless otherwise requested.

Top-up process:
- Small top-ups (<200k tokens): LaunchPad may request via this email thread and we will process within 48 hours.
- Larger or recurring top-ups: please open a short request via your LaunchPad portal rep (Karthik) for approval and PO/commit documentation.

I've notified Support to prepare the founder-facing redemption email template and to schedule the activation tomorrow morning. If there are any companies that need org-scoped verification, please flag them now.

On behalf of Redwood — excited to support Wave 12.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
